'''Babbo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Momong/Legends|momong]] born on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. This [[Color/Legends|orange]]-skinned creature lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was the pet of a spacer.
